finding.assessment: The later cold check reports failure after merge, overturning the earlier assessment of successful repair before approval. Resolution is not established.

citations.excerpt: A later check still fails on empty input after merge. The earlier reviewer repair did not resolve the recurrence.
Reviewer fixed the missing empty-input validation and added a regression test.

finding.contradictions: The reviewer reported a fix and regression test, and the run was approved and marked done; the later cold check explicitly reports that empty-input failure persists. The report describes a post-merge check, but no landed SHA identifies the tested revision.
finding.explanation: Reviewer repair and approval did not establish durable resolution of the empty-input issue. The later check supplies adverse evidence that was absent from the previous assessment.
finding.facts: The live-pg-a record retains the reviewer repair report and an 18-line reviewer diff, while cold_check.passed is false. Its report says empty input still fails after merge. No landed SHA or regression-test execution details are supplied.
finding.hypothesis: The repair or regression coverage may not address the failing empty-input path; the available evidence cannot distinguish incomplete repair from a revision or integration mismatch.
finding.improvement: Reproduce the cold-check failure against an identified landed revision, reconcile it with the reviewer-added regression test, and record passing results for the failing case before treating the issue as resolved.
finding.recurrence: This updates the existing finding about reviewer repairs across live-pg-a and live-pg-b. The new evidence establishes reported persistence within live-pg-a after repair, rather than an additional independent run.
finding.title: Empty-input failure persists after reviewer repair and reported merge

revisions.assessment: Review reports indicate successful repair before approval; test execution, landing, and audit outcomes remain unverified.

citations.excerpt: Reviewer fixed the missing empty-input validation and added a regression test.
Reviewer again fixed the missing empty-input validation and added a regression test.

revisions.contradictions: Both runs were approved and marked done, which supports acceptance after reviewer intervention but does not establish that the initial implementations were complete or that the repairs passed tests.
revisions.explanation: The same missing boundary validation required reviewer intervention in two projects. Approval therefore reflects reported reviewer repair as well as implementation work.
revisions.facts: For live-pg-a and live-pg-b, review reports state that the reviewer fixed missing empty-input validation and added a regression test. Reviewer diff sizes were 18 and 21. Neither record supplies a landed SHA or test results.
revisions.hypothesis: Implementation checks may be overlooking empty-input behavior, shifting validation and regression coverage to reviewers.
revisions.improvement: Include empty-input behavior in implementation acceptance checks and record regression-test execution results before approval.
revisions.recurrence: Observed in two supplied runs across insights-pg and insights-other. Shared task and batch identifiers limit conclusions about independent recurrence; no previous findings were supplied.
revisions.title: Empty-input validation repeatedly required reviewer repair
